text: Mobile app development is a popular field today. When creating an app, developers must consider responsive design so it looks good on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform approaches. Native apps are built for one system, like Android or iOS, and often perform better. Cross-platform apps work on several systems at once, which saves time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. However, performance matters a lot. Users expect apps to run quickly and smoothly, so developers must test carefully and fix problems before release.
